title: Waiting for the Rain
subject: English
summary: “Waiting for the Rain” is a poem about the importance of rain in our lives. It describes how people, animals, plants and birds eagerly wait for the rain during the hot and dry season. The earth becomes dry, rivers and ponds lose water, and plants begin to suffer without rainfall. When the rain finally arrives, it brings happiness and relief to everyone. The fields become green, flowers bloom and nature looks fresh and beautiful again. The poem teaches us that rain is very important for all living beings, and we should value and conserve water.
